rows.grounds: optative verb expressing a prescribed ritual action
compound describing the mustard seed as endowed with salt
specifies the time for the ritual offering
refers back to the previously stated outcome of destroying enemies

items.question: What nocturnal offering secures the swift destruction of enemies?
premises: A prior mantra practice aims at destroying enemies.
Mustard seeds can be prepared mixed with salt.
A ritual offering may be performed at night.
items.inference: Offering salt-mixed mustard seeds at night accomplishes that intended result.
uncertainties: The exact ritual fire context for juhuyāl is implied but not explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: At night, one should offer mustard seeds mixed with salt to achieve that result.
